optimizedDescription.value: Pure buildSchema: SchemaYamlData+templates → Schema with ID/DAG/template/workflow semantic validation.

optimizedContext.value:
# buildSchema

## Rules
- Sync pure fn: `buildSchema(ref, data: SchemaYamlData, templates) → Schema` in `domain/services/build-schema.ts`. No I/O.
- SchemaYamlData plain interface (not Zod): name, version, description?, kind schema|schema-plugin, extends?, artifacts, workflow?, metadataExtraction?.
- Validate artifact.id `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; array entry ids `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/` unique in array; hooks unique across ALL workflow steps. Dup artifact/step → SchemaValidationError.
- Template path must exist in templates map. requiresTaskCompletion ⊂ requires + taskCompletionCheck on type.
- Artifact DAG: known requires refs; non-optional must not depend on optional; acyclic (detectCycle DFS).
- Helpers: buildSelector, buildValidationRule, buildFieldMapping, buildExtractor, buildMetadataExtractorEntry, buildMetadataExtraction, buildArtifactType (defaults optional/delta false, requires []). Relocate buildSelector from infra Zod module.
- Construct `new Schema(name, version, artifacts, workflow, metadataExtraction)` + kind/extends.

## Constraints
- Pure: no fs/yaml/zod. domain/services only. Intermediate types plain TS. Errors: SchemaValidationError. Templates pre-loaded.
